courses.title: American Popular Culture
courses.choice_note: Catalog lists options as: AMS 2300; or AMS 2341. [1] Curriculum Requirements can be fulfilled by other approved courses from accredited institutions of higher education. The courses listed are recommended as the most efficient way to satisfy both Core Curriculum and Major Requirements at UT Dallas. [2] A required major course that also fulfills core curriculum requirements.
